apihelp-constel-createexcerpt-summary: Create a section (§) on the current revision of a page, coded with its first concept.
apihelp-constel-createexcerpt-param-titl: Title of the page. Cannot be used together with <var>$1pageid</var>.
apihelp-constel-createexcerpt-param-page: ID of the page. Cannot be used together with <var>$1title</var>.
apihelp-constel-createexcerpt-param-revi: Revision the reader is viewing. Must be the page's latest revision.
apihelp-constel-createexcerpt-param-exac: The selected section, as plain rendered text.
apihelp-constel-createexcerpt-param-pref: Text immediately before the section, to locate it unambiguously.
apihelp-constel-createexcerpt-param-suff: Text immediately after the section, to locate it unambiguously.
apihelp-constel-createexcerpt-param-star: Position of the section in the page's plain rendered text, in Unicode code points.
apihelp-constel-createexcerpt-param-conc: Concept label. Identity is strict, as for page titles.
apihelp-constel-createexcerpt-param-allo: Create the concept even if concepts that differ only in accents, case or spacing already exist.
apihelp-constel-codeexcerpt-param-concep: Concept label. Identity is strict, as for page titles.
apihelp-constel-codeexcerpt-param-allowv: Create the concept even if concepts that differ only in accents, case or spacing already exist.
apihelp-constel-createexcerpt-example-1: Create a section on page <kbd>Amereida</kbd> coded as <kbd>Travesía</kbd>.
apihelp-constel-codeexcerpt-summary: Add a concept to one of your sections (§).
apihelp-constel-uncodeexcerpt-summary: Remove a concept from one of your sections (§). A section left without concepts is deleted.
apihelp-constel-uncodeexcerpt-param-conc: ID of the concept to remove.
apihelp-constel-deleteexcerpt-summary: Delete a section (§): your own, or anyone's with the constel-moderate right.
apihelp-constel-theme-summary: Create, rename or delete one of your themes. Deleting a theme ungroups its concepts and deletes its notes.
apihelp-constel-groupconcept-summary: Put a concept into one of your themes (moving it out of another of yours), or take it out.
apihelp-constel-themenote-summary: Write the development of one of your themes (one per theme); empty text deletes it.
apihelp-constel-themenote-param-text: Text of the development. Empty deletes it.
apihelp-query+constelexcerpts-summary: List sections (§): the anchored ones on a page, or all of a reader's, including lost ones.
apihelp-query+constelexcerpts-param-page: List the anchored sections on this page.
apihelp-query+constelexcerpts-param-user: List all sections by this user.
apihelp-query+constelconcepts-summary: Search the shared vocabulary of concepts.
apihelp-query+constelconcepts-param-sear: Concepts whose label starts like this text, ignoring accents and case; most used first.
apihelp-query+constelconcepts-param-vari: Concepts that differ from this label only in accents, case or spacing.
apihelp-query+constelthemes-summary: List a reader's themes, with their concepts and notes.
apihelp-query+constelthemes-param-user: List the themes of these users.
apierror-constel-notnamed: You need a registered account to annotate with con§tel.
apierror-constel-noexcerpt: There is no section with ID $1.
apierror-constel-notyours: You can only change your own sections, themes and notes.
apierror-constel-toolong: The text exceeds the maximum of $1 {{PLURAL:$1|character|characters}}.
apierror-constel-tooshort: The section must have at least $1 {{PLURAL:$1|character|characters}}.
apierror-constel-variants: The concept "$1" does not exist, but there {{PLURAL:$2|is a similar one|are similar ones}}: $3. Choose one, or confirm that you want to create "$1".
apierror-constel-notannotatable: This page cannot be annotated: it must be an existing content page and not a redirect.
apierror-constel-staleview: The page changed since you loaded it. Reload it and select the section again.
apierror-constel-norender: The page could not be rendered to locate the section.
apierror-constel-anchornotfound: The selected section could not be located in the page text.
apierror-constel-alreadycoded: The section already has that concept.
apierror-constel-notcoded: The section does not have that concept.
apierror-constel-notheme: There is no theme with ID $1.
apierror-constel-nonote: There is no note with ID $1.
apierror-constel-noconcept: There is no concept with ID $1.
apihelp-query+constelgraph-summary: The concept map: concepts with their frequencies, and the links between them (same section, or overlapping sections by different readers).
apihelp-query+constelexcerpts-param-conc: List the sections coded with this concept, including lost ones.
apihelp-query+constelconcepts-param-them: Include the themes (of any reader) that contain each concept.
apihelp-constel-moderate-summary: Moderate the shared vocabulary: rename a concept, or merge it into another. Requires the constel-moderate right; recorded in the con§tel log.
apihelp-constel-moderate-param-concept: ID of the concept to rename, or to merge (it disappears).
apihelp-constel-moderate-param-into: ID of the concept that is kept (for <kbd>merge</kbd>).
apierror-constel-labeltaken: The label "$1" already belongs to another concept: merge them instead.
apierror-constel-mergeself: A concept cannot be merged into itself.
apierror-constel-frozen: The page of this section was deleted: the section can only be deleted.
apihelp-constel-glossexcerpt-summary: Write, change or clear (empty) the gloss of one of your sections (§): a comment or clarification.
apihelp-constel-createexcerpt-param-glos: Optional gloss: a comment or clarification on the section.
apihelp-query+constelgraph-param-users: Only the sections (§) of these readers. Empty: everyone's.
apihelp-query+constelgraph-param-pageids: Only the sections (§) on these pages. Empty: all pages.
apihelp-query+constelreaders-summary: The readers of con§tel (people with sections or themes), with the name to show: their real name if they set one in their preferences, otherwise their username.
apihelp-query+constelreaders-param-searc: Readers whose real name or username contains this text, ignoring accents and case.
apihelp-query+constelreaders-param-names: The name to show for these usernames.
